name: step along mutually conjugate directions
mechanism: choose each search direction as the current negative gradient corrected to be conjugate to the previous directions with respect to the curvature, so on a quadratic each direction is never undone and the exact optimum is reached in as many steps as dimensions

sources.ref: List of algorithms (revid 1373672109), entry 'Conjugate gradient methods (see more https' in section Computational mathematics / Optimization algorithms: //doi.org/10.1016/j.jksus.2022.101923)

requires: a symmetric positive-definite curvature (or a nonlinear extension with restarts)
fails_when: loss of conjugacy on non-quadratics; needs restarts
